0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, 14th in the West, 0-2 on the road, on a five-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, 11th in the West, on a three-game winning streak) for the Jazz's eighth game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while New Orleans is missing Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Jazz lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City, and they lost all three meetings with New Orleans in 2025-26.
